name: Skin smoothing
description: Skin in a portrait or live video evened out, blemishes and blotches softened, while eyes, brows and lips stay sharp and some fine texture is kept.

name: Dewy glow
description: A soft, warm glow blooming from the highlights of skin, with a sheen on its brightest parts, for a fresh, dewy look.

name: Soft focus
description: A dreamy diffusion-filter look: highlights bleed softly into the picture, contrast eases and the shadows lift in a faint haze.

name: Brighten eyes and teeth
description: The whites of the eyes or a smile brightened and whitened in a region, the yellow taken out, while the skin round them is left alone.

name: Lip tint
description: Lipstick laid on lips in a region: any shade, as sheer or as deep as you like, with a wet gloss along the lower lip, the lips' texture showing through.

name: Blush
description: A soft flush of colour on both cheeks, fading out at the edges, any shade, the skin's texture showing through.

name: Eyeshadow
description: Two-tone eyeshadow on both lids, deepest at the lash line and outer corners and blended up to the crease, with an optional twinkling shimmer.

controls.l: Skin only (keeps eyes and lashes bare)

name: Highlighter
description: A luminous sheen on both cheekbones, its finely milled glitter twinkling as the light catches it.

name: Retouch reveal
description: A portrait split by a sweeping divider: as it was on one side, retouched on the other, skin smoothed, glowing and warmed.

name: Product shine
description: A bright glint sweeping across a product shot, then four-point sparkles twinkling on it in turn, as in a cosmetics ad.

name: Lipstick swipe
description: A creamy lipstick swatch swiped across the frame with a glossy streak along it, then the shade's name fading in beneath.

name: Swatch reveal
description: A row of shade swatches popping in one after another with a satin sheen, each with its name fading in below, like a cosmetics range.

name: Redact box
description: Black redaction bars drawn line by line over part of a screenshot or video, then a REDACTED stamp slammed on top.

name: Redaction bars
description: Black marker bars drawn one after another over lines of a picture, like a redacted document, then wiped away.

name: Scramble censor
description: Part of a picture or video broken into shuffled, flipped blocks with digital noise, reshuffling several times a second.

name: Blur censor
description: Part of a picture or video blurred beyond recognition, as for a face or a screen, or everything but it blurred for focus.

name: Pixelate censor
description: Part of a picture or video hidden behind big mosaic blocks, as for a face or a number plate, the blocks shimmering like a live censor.

name: Rolodex
description: Cards on a rolodex spindle flipping down one after another, each showing a figure and its label, for rotating stats, quotes or names.

controls.d: signed up this month, on the App Store, over the last year, and counting

texts.name: labels
texts.label: Labels (comma separated)

name: Riffle shuffle
description: A deck of cards cut in two and riffled back together, the cards dropping in from either side in turn before the deck is tapped square, over and over.

name: Cover flow
description: A ring of picture cards turning in perspective, stepping round so each comes to the front in turn, mirrored on a glossy floor.
